diffs.message: switch-not-checkbox: The toggle is an <input type="checkbox"> with role="switch" added. The API reference lists no Switch component, so the diff does not use a design-system switch control. It relies on a native checkbox with an ARIA role override, which is a checkbox underneath and does not clearly meet the 'system's on/off switch control, not checkboxes' requirement.
